# Vaylo

> Vaylo is smart water leak detection with automatic shutoff for homes, condos and buildings. It is physical AI: sensors for water, humidity and temperature feed a local AI that learns what is normal in every room and closes the main water valve in seconds when something is wrong. Works with Alexa, Google Home, Apple Home and SmartThings through Matter. Launching in the United States in 2027, starting in Florida.

## Key facts

- Product: Control Unit (battery backup, local AI, works offline), motorized Smart Valve for ½" to 1½" main lines (weatherproof, can be mounted outdoors), wireless Combo Sensors (water, temperature, humidity), Spot Sensors and a supervised sensor cable.
- What makes it different: it learns normal water use room by room, so a long shower or bath time does not trigger a shutoff, while a slow leak under a sink does. Users can pause an alert ("I've got this") and Vaylo learns from the reason.
- Alerts: app notifications, SMS, email, and voice announcements on smart speakers, smart displays and TVs.
- Climate: freeze protection in cold climates; humidity and mold-risk alerts in hot, humid climates such as Florida, with AC or dehumidifier control through a Matter thermostat.
- Installation: sensors are do-it-yourself; the valve is installed by a plumber in under an hour with standard tools, no electrician needed. Customers can start with sensors only and add the valve later.
- Buildings: per-unit valves and sensors, one building portal with alerts, audit log and work-order export; Home SOS lets residents report water from neighboring units.
- Next: the same sensors and local AI will listen for abnormal sounds from pumps, AC units and water heaters and book service before things break.
- Company: Vaylo is made by Gorilla Forge. The team has 30 years of experience in building technology, smart homes and leak protection, with roots in Norway.
- Pricing: announced at launch.
- Status: pre-launch. Specifications and certifications are targets until launch.

## FAQ

### What is Vaylo?

Vaylo is a smart water leak protection system for homes and buildings. It combines a Control Unit, a motorized shutoff valve on the main water line and wireless sensors for water, temperature and humidity. Vaylo learns what normal water use looks like in each room and shuts off the water automatically when something is wrong.

### How does automatic water shutoff work?

When a sensor detects water where it shouldn't be, or flow that doesn't match your normal patterns, Vaylo alerts you first. If the risk is real and nobody responds, the Smart Valve on your main line closes in seconds. Decisions are made locally in the Control Unit, so protection keeps working even if the internet is down.

### What does physical AI mean for a home?

Physical AI is artificial intelligence that senses and acts in the real world instead of on a screen. Vaylo senses water, humidity and temperature room by room, learns your home's own patterns such as long showers or the washing machine, and acts on its own: it asks, warns or shuts off the water.

### Will it shut off my water when I take a long shower?

No. Vaylo learns which rooms are wet on purpose. A long shower or bath time is recognized as normal, while a slow leak under a sink is not. You can also tell Vaylo "I've got this" to pause an alert, and it learns from the reason you give.

### Does Vaylo work with Alexa, Google Home and Apple Home?

Yes. Vaylo is designed for Matter and works with Amazon Alexa, Google Home, Apple Home and Samsung SmartThings. Alerts can come as app notifications, SMS, email and voice announcements on smart speakers and displays.

### Can Vaylo help prevent mold in Florida and other humid climates?

Yes. Combo Sensors track humidity and temperature in every room and warn about mold risk early. Through a Matter thermostat, Vaylo can switch on the AC or dehumidifier when humidity climbs, which matters most in seasonal homes that stand empty for months.

### Does it protect against frozen pipes?

Yes. Vaylo watches temperatures near pipes in attics, crawlspaces and basements and can shut off the water automatically before a freeze turns into a burst pipe.

### My main shutoff valve is outside. Can Vaylo be installed there?

Yes. The Smart Valve is weatherproof and can be mounted outdoors, with a frost-safe insulated cover for cold climates and a UV- and storm-proof cover for hot ones.

### Do I need a plumber to install Vaylo?

Sensors are wireless and you place them yourself in minutes. The Smart Valve goes on the main water line and is installed by a plumber in under an hour with standard tools. It fits pipes from ½" to 1½" and needs no electrician. You can also start with sensors only and add the valve later.

### Does Vaylo work for condos and apartment buildings?

Yes. Each unit gets its own valve and sensors, and building managers see every unit on one screen with alerts, an audit log and work-order export. Residents can report water coming from a neighbor with Home SOS, and Vaylo checks the surrounding units.

### What happens during a power outage?

The Control Unit has battery backup, so it can still close the valve during a power outage. Sensors are battery powered and run a daily self-test.

### When can I buy Vaylo?

Vaylo launches in the United States in 2027, starting in Florida. Join the early-access list to be first in line. Plumbers, builders, property managers and distribution partners can contact us at hello@getvaylo.io.
